translation.name: YAUBADA BONANA VEYAO IVAGUNA Bona Iduna

content: Yesu kaliva nimana koyona sabati againe gikiveyamumuna.
Kadu tova saꞋeyana Yesu manuwa-abavehawala ana egana sinagogi againe giluku. Medede againe kaliva saꞋeyana gimiyami, nimana gifwalele-vagata.
Kaliva tufoidi nuwanuwadi Yesu yana dewa hinahawavekoyoyena faꞋina, Bana hiꞋitaꞋita-kwanekwanena be hinaꞋitana kaꞋi nimakoyo sabati againe ginakiveyamumuna o kaꞋi keke.
Yesu nimakoyo againe gigahe gigayo, “UꞋela weꞋai.”

Ada tolauboda agaidiya gigahe gigayo, “Yada buki-vehimeya sabati faꞋina gavaimi givehimeyeda? KaꞋi kaliva sabati againe kanakiveyamumuna o kaꞋi kanakivekoyona? KaꞋi kanalugolegolena o kaꞋi kanaluveꞋalikana?” Hidedemi Yesu gitoliluvaluva tu badi hiveꞋamata.
Ada keke nimakoyo hidaꞋitanuwakabubuyeni faꞋina, Yesu aseꞋasena giꞋuꞋaulolo ada yana wanuwakoyo gilumataviledi tu nimakoyo againe gigahe gigayo, “Nima utune.” Nimana gitunena ada auheꞋama giyamumu.
Badi Falisi hihobu be hina Helodi yana yoꞋo kalivadi buye hivagaꞋauta hivevai be higa gavaiyaꞋamine Yesu hinaluveꞋalikani.
Kaliva Yesu againe hiyoꞋoyoꞋo Galili ana tobu liline.

Tu Yesu mena melala gihege tu ana tomuliya buye hina Galili ana tobu liline, ada yoꞋo lakahi-moꞋena hibwaꞋulina. Fafali moyaꞋaina agaidiya hitauya, Galili ana fafali Yudiya ana fafali Yelusalema ana melala Idumiya ana fafali kadu melala moyaꞋaina yuwa Yolidani fafaline, kadu Taiya Saidoni adi melala moyaꞋaina agaidiya hitauya. Gavadi gavadi moyaꞋaina gififaisewana-ma valeyana hinogalina againe hivagaꞋauta.
Ada yoꞋo lakahi-moꞋedi faꞋina Yesu ana tomuliya gigahedi gigayo, “Waka kabiꞋona wanaꞋihagihagiyena faꞋina kaliva hiyoꞋoyoꞋo be kaꞋi hinavetuwahegeku, au ganayage.”
Kaliva moyaꞋaidi gisiveyawadi faꞋina toꞋaulolo adi aulolo tulina tulina hiveveꞋatuwahega be hinakibwaꞋeni-yo hinayamumu.
Ada badi wayafunediyao hiꞋita-yo agene hibeꞋu hitatawayana higayo, “Iyoi. OꞋeni Yaubada Natuna.”
Atu Yesu gihawatadi toyogina be Bana inubana keke hinahawavemogataleni.
Yesu afositolo tuwelo givenuwadadanedi.
Tu Yesu oyeya gilaka ada kaliva gaveyao nuwanuwana, medema giyowanidi be Bana againe hilakaꞋela.

Ada kaliva tuwelo givegidedi ada givewagadi afositolo higa bonana ana towahidadana. Givegidedi be higa badi Bana buye hinamiyami kadu ginaꞋiveninisedi be hinalulumamala, ada abavehimeya ginaveledi-yo yafune hinawavidi.
Ada kaliva tuwelo givenuwadadanedi-ma adi egana hidede amine. Saimoni tu ana egana velugana givelena-ma Fita.
Yemesa kadu taina Yoni Sebedi natuneyao tu adi egana velugana giveledi-ma Bowanedisi, higa ana kaivila atala natuneyao faꞋina yadi gahe vaita atala amine.
Kadu Anidulu Filifi Batolomiu Madiu Tomasi Yemesa Alifiyo natuna, kadu Tadiyasi, kadu Saimoni bana yoꞋo miLoma hivenibainedi-ma kalivana.
Kadu Yudasi-Isikaliyota bana Yesu nibaineyao nimadiya gihawavemogatalena amanadi.
Tufoidi higahe vaita Biyelisibuli higa Setani
Yesu gidaluvaiyeni.
Yesu yana yoꞋo tuwelo givegidedi gihavaina, giyewana yana manuweya. KaduꞋe kaliva hiyoꞋoyoꞋo faꞋina, Bana ana tomuliya buye keke adifaiweya hinaꞋa.
Ma ana unuma hidedemi hinogalina againe, hilowoga be hinavegaꞋaulena faꞋina higahegahe higayo, “Givekabakabaleya.”
Ada Mosese yana vehimeya ana tovehawala Yelusalema againe hitauya-ma higahe higayo, “Biyelisibuli giluvaiyena. Bana Biyelisibuli yafune adi tovehimeya yana faiwala againe yafune giwaviwavidi.”
Hidede amine higahegahe faꞋina Yesu giyowanidi be hiꞋela, gahetalahobuhobu amine gilukahihiyedi gigayo, “Keke Setani tauna ginawavini, keke-moꞋa.
Hai fafali ana melala tulina tulina buye hilulugaviya, medema taudiyao hinavehavaidi.
Kadu hai yoꞋo ana kaliva tova moyaꞋaina buye hivekwavekwageya, medema hinaꞋabiꞋotaꞋota be yoꞋo ana egana ginahavaina.
Meda anafaiweya kaꞋi Setani tauna yana yoꞋo higa yafune ginavekwageyedi be ginawavidi digo, bana tauna yana yoꞋo ginavehavaidi ada au yana abavehimeya ginahavaina.

KaꞋi kaliva manimaninina yana manuweya ginamiyami, au keke tamo hakwadi anafaiweya ginaluku kaliva yana lokoloko ginavaini. Nagona kaliva manimaninina ginayogoni-yo yana lokoloko ginavaina. Meda anafaiweya Iya Setani ganayogoni-yo kaliva wayafunedi ganaꞋihagihagiyedi.
Gagahe velemoꞋena, Yaubada kaliva yadi dewa koyona tulina tulina ginayawelina, kadu gavadi gavadi yadi gahe-kawowo againe Yaubada hinahawatagona-ma ginavenuwauluyena.
Atu hai kaliva yana gahe-kawowo againe AluꞋaluwa Mahalina ginahawatagona, medema yana koyona Yaubada keke ginayawelini, keke-moꞋa. Au yana hawatagona ana vita ginawahi-vagahina.”
Yesu hidede amine gigahe, faꞋina AluꞋaluwa Mahalina yana faiwala againe yafune giwaviwavidi tu badi kaliva higahe vaita yafune Yesu gidaluvaiyeni.
Yesu hinana kadu taineyao hilakayemu.
Yesu gimiyami tu hinana kadu tobohiyaneyao hilakayemu. Melaleya himidimidi tu kaliva saꞋeyana higahena be Yesu ginagahena.
YoꞋo hitogafifina ada higahena higayo, “Hina kadu tobohiyamomo melaleya himimiyami, nuwanuwadi hinaꞋita.”
Bana Yesu gigayo, “HakwaꞋadi hinaku? Kadu gaveyao tobohiyakweyao?”
Ada badi hitogafifina-ma gilumataviledi-yo gigahe gigayo, “Hidema hinaku kadu tobohiyakweyao.
FaꞋina hai kaliva o vevine Yaubada yana nuwanuwa hiꞋitaꞋitaveꞋavina, medema tobohiyaku o nouku o hinaku.” Hidedemi Yesu gigahe.
